description: Main window and the quick tools windows (src/quick.rs), the ring, the phone's files arriving (src/arrival.rs), and Ask ZOOD's island, pointer and glow (src/ask/): core APIs, dragging the window by its toolbar (the title bar on macOS), the native open/save dialogs, and file reads/writes limited to paths the user picked in a dialog or dropped on the window (the dialog plugin adds picked paths to the fs scope at runtime; no static fs scope is granted).
